topography.project_purpose: Basis Trading. Structurally: 120 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 10 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 13 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, accesscontrolupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
